verdict.rationale: A framework could plausibly have an official hosting or deploy platform with a public status page, so this axis applies to Svelte. The evidence pack shows no official Svelte hosting platform, status page, or incident history. adapter-vercel is a deploy adapter for a third-party host and is not the product's own status page.

support.subject: As a developer, I can check a public status page and incident history for the framework's official hosting/deploy platform before relying on it in production
